iconicAnchor.label: Riot Grrrl and punk self-published zine networks
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: Punk participants using low-budget self-publication for direct community speech
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The Smithsonian archive identifies low-budget zines, collaged art, personal statements, manifestos, and informal distribution as a voice for underground punk and activist communities.

sources.title: Ocho y Media Collection
supports: Punk-related zines are small, low-budget publications containing collaged art, personal writing, manifestos, and community knowledge.
Informal circulation and political or social messages support the guide's direct, participatory editorial stance.

sources.title: Girls Speak Out with Zines
supports: Folded paper and easy copying made zines accessible channels for sharing ideas and building connections.
